misses.counterfactual_theory: A cutoff-linked record of frozen forecast specifications and issuance times could make it possible to compare the forecasts with their later outcomes. The supplied evidence does not establish that this would have changed any decision or result.
misses.decision_reference: EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE identify missing forecast contents, issuance times, and eligible evidence cutoffs. No qualifying pre-outcome decision or forecast specification is supplied.
misses.decision_relevance: Without the original forecast and timing provenance, target-time prices cannot be compared with what was forecast beforehand; whether any forecast was missed is undetermined.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: settlement records provide confirmed target-time BTC and ETH mark prices, but not the linked forecasts’ contents, issuance times, or eligible evidence cutoffs. They therefore do not demonstrate a decision miss or portfolio result.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent, preventing ex-ante alignment and miss assessment.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement evidence records provide point outcomes, including EXP-FC-f9b7fcc9fbc3e09be1f5 and EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36. These are target-time prices, not portfolio results, and cannot be assessed against absent forecast specifications.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
